About Us:
Our client is an electronic principal trading firm specialising in global market-making and arbitrage opportunities. Technology is central to their success, powering a unified trading platform and the micro-decisions required to thrive in competitive markets. Their scale and efficiency enable us to react swiftly to opportunities and regulatory changes while maintaining a robust operational risk management framework.
At the core of our business is our people – highly motivated and intelligent individuals who solve complex problems through sophisticated technology in a meritocratic, collaborative environment.
The Role:
As a Software Engineer, you will play a critical role at the centre of their trading systems. You will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining high-performance connections to global trading venues.
Key responsibilities include:
Build and maintain low-latency connectivity to trading venues, including both order gateways and market data feeds.
Coordinate with FIX brokers to manage projects from inception to delivery.
Lead and support exchange upgrade initiatives.
Monitor and analyse exchange-facing components, identifying and implementing optimisations for improved trading outcomes.
Work flexibly across real-time incident resolution and long-term development projects.
Conduct performance tuning to maximise throughput and minimise latency.
Requirements:
Strong programming skills in Java or C++
Proficiency in Python
Prior experience in a high-frequency trading environment
Minimum 2-3 years of high-frequency trading experience required
Experience with both Windows and Linux systems
Solid understanding of network protocols
Familiarity with protocols such as ITCH, OUCH, FLEX, Arrowhead, J-GATE, OMNET, FIX.
Must have Australian work rights
The Culture
They operate in a fast-paced, competitive environment where collaboration, innovation, and problem-solving are highly valued. Success here is driven by people who challenge ideas, share knowledge, and work together to achieve outstanding results.
They foster a culture that rewards teamwork as much as individual accomplishment, encouraging creativity, open communication, and continuous improvement. If you are motivated to push boundaries and deliver excellence, you will thrive in their team.
Please click the apply button today.
